source_name: Zaposli.ME — job portal with employer- and sector-scoped vacancy pages
why_relevant: Self-described as the most-visited employment site in Montenegro. Confirmed to expose employer-scoped pages (e.g. /oglasi-za-posao/erste-bank) and sector facets 'Bankarstvo', 'IT', 'Finansije', 'Ekonomija'. Individual vacancy URLs are slugged /posao/{id}/{employer}/{job-title} and carry publication dates plus expiry countdowns. Observed a live Erste Bank posting for a data-management team lead ('vođa tima za upravljanje podacima') — exactly the organisation-change signal this cell targets.

source_name: Prekoveze.me — HR platform with per-employer vacancy pages
why_relevant: Montenegrin online HR/business platform specialised in employer services; carries per-employer vacancy pages including one for Crnogorska Komercijalna Banka (CKB). Because it is HR-service-led, employers that use it tend to post structured, description-rich ads — good for extracting unit names, reporting lines and required certifications (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SWIFT, core banking).

source_name: Uprava za kadrove (Human Resources Authority) — Pregled oglasa
why_relevant: Central register of interni oglasi, javni oglasi and javni konkursi for state bodies. Relevant to this cell because financial-sector-adjacent public bodies (finance ministry, tax administration, regulators, state funds) recruit here, and senior public appointments are a leadership-move signal. Also the venue where public-sector payments/IT roles appear.

source_name: Portal eUprava Crne Gore — vacancy/competition notices
why_relevant: National e-government portal that republishes Uprava za kadrove calls and other official notices. Useful as a secondary/mirror channel and as a discovery surface for institutional publishers not yet in the actor map.

source_name: LinkedIn Jobs — Podgorica / Montenegro IT and banking listings
why_relevant: Highest-resolution source for senior and English-language roles that never reach the state bureau — regional/group-level positions at OTP (CKB), NLB, Erste, Addiko and Adriatic Bank, plus IT-in-finance vendors. Observed volumes of ~202 jobs in Podgorica and ~91 IT jobs in Montenegro give a usable baseline for measuring hiring intensity. LinkedIn company pages (e.g. Hipotekarna Banka) additionally reveal headcount trends and individual moves.

source_name: HelloWorld.rs — regional tech job board
why_relevant: Region-wide portal focused exclusively on the tech community. Where a Montenegrin bank or payment processor recruits engineers, core-banking/integration specialists or security staff for a regional tech brand, the ad often appears here with far richer technical detail (named core-banking platform, card switch, ISO 20022, PCI DSS) than a bureau ad — which is precisely the technology-stack intelligence this workstream wants.

source_name: MNEJobs.me — Montenegro job aggregator
why_relevant: Montenegro-specific aggregator advertising itself as the largest base of vacancies, updated daily and spanning all sectors. Useful as a redundancy layer: ads that appear here but not on ZZZCG indicate employers bypassing the bureau, and vice versa, which itself characterises an employer's hiring style.

source_name: Careerjet.me — Montenegro job search engine (banking query)
why_relevant: Meta-search engine that indexes many Montenegrin and regional boards behind one query string. The '/posao-banka' path is effectively a ready-made banking-vacancy feed and is a cheap way to discover boards not yet in the actor map (each result carries its origin site).

source_name: Pazar3.me — Posao / Informacione tehnologije classifieds
why_relevant: High-traffic Montenegrin classifieds site with a structured business/jobs/IT taxonomy. Smaller payment agents, exchange offices, fintech startups, POS/ATM service firms and IT vendors serving banks often advertise here and nowhere else — the long tail of the payments value chain that formal boards miss.

source_name: MojTrg.me — Posao / Informacione tehnologije classifieds
why_relevant: Second Montenegrin classifieds portal with an equivalent jobs/IT taxonomy; serves the same long-tail function as Pazar3 and provides redundancy where one site's listings are exclusive.

source_name: Lovćen Banka AD Podgorica — Karijera
why_relevant: First-party careers page ('Postanite dio LB tima') of a domestically-owned bank. Smaller domestic banks rarely syndicate to boards, so their own pages are often the only public vacancy channel and therefore the sole early signal of new units.

source_name: Universal Capital Bank AD Podgorica — Zapošljavanje
why_relevant: First-party employment page. Observed to operate as an open CV-intake channel rather than a listed-vacancy page, which is itself a finding: this bank's hiring is not publicly itemised, so organisation-change signal for it must be sought via ZZZCG filings, LinkedIn or trade press instead.

source_name: DEKRA Zapošljavanje d.o.o. Crna Gora — recruitment agency
why_relevant: Licensed employment-mediation agency in Podgorica (Bulevar Sv. Petra Cetinjskog 130) offering mediation/headhunting, assessment, organisational-climate surveys and outplacement. Agencies are an indirect but early channel: confidential senior banking searches are placed through them before any public ad, and 'outplacement' mandates are a downsizing signal.

source_name: Gi Group — Adriatic/Montenegro staffing operations
why_relevant: International staffing group active in the Adriatic region including Montenegro. Multinational agencies typically hold the mandates for regional bank shared-service and IT build-outs; their posted roles reveal where a group is placing capacity before any corporate announcement.

source_name: Uprava za inspekcijske poslove / Agencija za zapošljavanje registry document (gov.me)
why_relevant: A government-hosted document concerning employment-agency licensing/registration. If it is (or leads to) the register of licensed employment-mediation agencies, it yields the authoritative list of private recruiters operating in Montenegro — the actor list needed to systematically cover the indirect agency channel identified above.

source_name: CKB bank (Crnogorska komercijalna banka, OTP Group) — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Largest Montenegrin bank by assets; company page carries hiring posts, new-appointment congratulation posts, employee tab exposing org units (cards, digital, IT) not listed on ckb.me.

source_name: Hipotekarna Banka — LinkedIn official company page
why_relevant: Domestically owned bank very active on LinkedIn (product/contact-centre posts observed); duplicate legacy page also exists, so both must be tracked. Executive profiles (e.g. director of financial markets sector) are visible from posts.

source_name: Erste banka Crna Gora (Erste Bank AD Podgorica) — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Austrian-group subsidiary; page lists payment-services and card specialties and carries vacancies (internal auditor observed), useful for org-unit and hiring signals.

source_name: Lovćen banka AD Podgorica — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Smaller domestic bank; observed recruiting a contact-centre associate and announcing branch openings — early signals of channel/organisational expansion.

source_name: Adriatic Bank AD Podgorica — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Newer, growth-phase bank; teller and branch vacancies plus branch news (Tivat, Bar, Podgorica) indicate footprint and staffing direction.

source_name: Universal Capital Bank AD Podgorica — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Bank with brokerage/custody specialisation; page (c.1,173 followers) is the main public channel for its staffing and campaign activity.

source_name: Prva banka Crne Gore — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Domestically owned bank (~220 employees) whose website communicates little; LinkedIn is a comparatively richer channel for staffing and management signals.

source_name: ASEE (Asseco South Eastern Europe) — LinkedIn company page and Jobs tab
why_relevant: Parent of Payten and core-banking/digital-banking supplier to ME banks; Montenegro-located vacancies here are a leading indicator of bank IT projects before the bank announces anything.

source_name: LinkedIn people search / 'new role' announcement posts (sr + en phrasings)
why_relevant: Individuals publish role changes before employers do. Serbian/Montenegrin phrasings ('nova uloga', 'sa zadovoljstvom objavljujem', 'novi izazov', 'pridružio/la sam se', 'imenovan') plus English ('excited to announce', 'thrilled to share') are the earliest leadership-move signal available.

source_name: ZoomInfo — Crnogorska Komercijalna Banka employee directory / people profiles
why_relevant: Aggregator mirroring LinkedIn-derived role data; observed titles such as 'Head of IT, Development' and HR legal-affairs specialist reveal internal org units. Useful as a cross-check when LinkedIn's people tab is walled.

source_name: SignalHire company profiles (banking, SEE/Montenegro)
why_relevant: Second-tier people aggregator; useful triangulation when ZoomInfo and LinkedIn disagree on a person's current employer, and it indexes some smaller Balkan financial entities.

source_name: EMIS company profile — key executives, Montenegrin banks
why_relevant: Commercial business-intelligence profile with a 'key executives' block per ME bank; a structured counterweight to self-reported LinkedIn titles and helpful for confirming board-level moves.
